title: Interactive Rollback Playbook — Guided Quick-Revert Flow for Canary & A/B
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design an interactive "quick-revert" playbook surface within Redwood Console that guides engineers through an expedited rollback for canary and A/B rollout modes. The intent is to reduce decision time and human error during incidents by offering a pre-validated, explainable rollback path with one-click execution, simulation preview, and post-revert audit snapshot. Target personas: SREs, platform engineers, product managers on-call.
acceptance_criteria: UI presents a single consolidated rollback panel for active rollouts (canary/A-B) showing: current traffic split, recent signal deltas (error/latency/regressions), and recommended revert action
Primary action allows rollback to previous stable variant in <= 3 clicks and surfaces required scope (routes, model version, region) before execution
Preview simulator shows estimated impact on traffic and latency (best-effort) and highlights any incompatible routes or dependent deployments
Change is recorded as an auditable event linked to the rollout and emits a console notification and runbook link
Design provides keyboard-first quick-undo (re-apply previous traffic) and a visual diff card comparing pre/post metrics for first 10 minutes
design_notes: We prioritized a guided flow rather than a free-form editor to minimize cognitive load under incident pressure.
Introduce a lightweight safety-check modal that validates dependencies (services using variant A, region constraints) before committing the revert.
Explained decisions: do not auto-rollback on signal thresholds in this MVP — instead recommend and surface one-click revert; automatic rollback is planned as a separate ENG initiative.
Considered alternatives: 'time-travel' traffic slider vs. snapshot reversion. Chose snapshot reversion for clarity and auditability.
Accessibility: ensure color-independent signal cues and ARIA labels for all actionable controls; default focus lands on primary undo action after modal confirmation.
Mobile: condensed variant list and stacked metrics card for on-call mobile view; full simulator reserved for desktop.
Metrics surfaced: 1) request error rate delta, 2) median latency delta, 3) posters for quality regressions (if available from evals).
